text:
Logan Cooley has 10 goals in his last ten games, two hat tricks in that stretch, and a fifth career hat trick that FOX 13 News Utah called NHL history. At 22 he has 21 points in 18 games, 14 of them on the power play.

Some of this is real, some of it is a hot stick. His chances are up: 4.6 expected goals on his own shots over the last ten games against 3.5 usual (expected goals measure the quality of chances). The finishing is not sustainable. He has 11 goals on 6.28 expected and is shooting 35%, against 24% last season, and that rate rarely holds for anyone.

What lasts is the skating and the setup work: 99th percentile top speed, and Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had him carrying the puck in on 56% of his entries last season with 8.4 primary shot assists per 60. With him on the ice at 5v5, Utah gets 57.8% of the expected goals. Our projection has him around 80 points at his current ice time; we'd expect the goals to slow and the assists to fill the gap.
headline: Cooley is making history, and some of it will last
